kiosk.settings.title: Kiosk display
kiosk.settings.display_mode.hint: Full page fills your browser window; full screen also hides the browser's tabs and address bar (a user gesture is needed to enter it).
kiosk.settings.intro: Choose what your kiosk display shows. Add an entry, pick its type and the item, and set how long it stays on screen and whether it scrolls when it doesn't fit. Entries play from top to bottom. This is your playlist; it only shapes your own kiosk. Then use “Preview the kiosk” below to see it run.
kiosk.settings.refresh_interval_hint: How often the kiosk checks the slide on screen for changes (seconds, at least 2). Default 10.
kiosk.settings.tip: With automatic scrolling, an entry stays on screen until it has scrolled to the end, even if that takes longer than its duration. If it reaches the end sooner, it scrolls back to the top for the rest of its time.
kiosk.settings.default_duration_hint: New entries start with this duration (5–3600 seconds). Default 30.
kiosk.settings.scroll_speed_hint: How fast entries set to scroll automatically move down the page.
kiosk.settings.item_placeholder: Search, or pick from the list
kiosk.settings.item_error: Could not load items. Try again.
kiosk.settings.item_unavailable: The item you picked is no longer available.
kiosk.settings.empty: No entries yet. Use “Add entry” to put something on your kiosk.
kiosk.settings.shared_intro: A shared link lets anyone who has it watch your kiosk display without signing in. Only items visible to the whole community are shown (private items are skipped). The link is revocable; once revoked it cannot be restored.
kiosk.settings.link_created: Your shared link is ready. Copy it now — it will not be shown again.
kiosk.settings.revoke_confirm: Revoke this shared link? It will stop working immediately and cannot be undone.
kiosk.settings.shared_empty: No shared links yet. Use “Create link” to make one for a wall screen or shared display.
